newsitem.title: USA: Medical Action COO sees FY98 earings rise.
newsitem.headline: Medical Action COO sees FY98 earings rise.

text.p: Medical Action Industries Inc's President and Chief Operating Officer, Paul Meringola, said Thursday the company anticipates a substantial increase in revenue and earnings in fiscal 1998 ending March 31.
Meringola said "Medical Action . . . is commited to using the opportunity created by today's healthcare environment to increase revenues and earnings."
Meringola concluded that the company will "grow through a combination of strategic acquisitions, new market entries and internal product development."
Medical Action develops, manufactures, markets and distributes a variety of disposable surgical-related products.
